stem: Two rooms both average 700 µmol·m⁻²·s⁻¹ at canopy height. Room A runs 12 hours of light and Room B runs 18 hours. Which conclusion is best supported?
choices: Both rooms have the same DLI because PPFD is identical
Room B has the higher DLI because the photoperiod is longer
Room A has the higher DLI because shorter days concentrate photons
DLI cannot be compared unless fixture wattage is known
rationale: DLI depends on both PPFD and photoperiod. With equal average PPFD, the longer 18-hour photoperiod produces a larger daily photon dose.
